messages:
incident-bot: Pager fired: high error rate on region-us-west-az6 / inference-serving
pagerduty: PD alert created -> INCIDENT-7289. Notified: on-call ops.
Anna K: acked via pagerduty. I'm on it. grabbing logs now.
Rahul P: thx anna. quick FYI: monitoring shows 5xx spike starting ~2498765400 and sustained CPU on model shard hosts in az6.
Evan G: adding context — autoscaler shows surge, but some nodes are in Terminating state due to NIC flaps reported by the infra fabric team.
Cheng L: seeing repeated TLS handshake failures to endpoint pool-az6-rt-5. suspect network interface instability. traceroute to host shows intermittent packet loss.
Anna K: rolling mitigation plan: 1) route critical traffic to region-us-west-az4 as fallback (low-risk models), 2) spin emergency replacement hosts in az6 with different NIC driver profile, 3) pause server drain for current upgrade rollout in az6.
Oncall Rotation: assigning followups — rahul take routing, evan take infra replacement, cheng handle logs and customer impact. I'll coordinate comms.
Rahul P: starting route update now. Updating smart-routing policy to bias away from az6 by lowering weight to 0.2 for 15m. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing set-weight --region us-west --zone az6 --weight 0.2 --duration 15m --reason "az6 NIC instability"
```
Rahul P: pushed rule, verifying traffic shift... seeing immediate 30% drop in az6 qps, latency stable for most routes.
Evan G: provisioning replacement hosts with driver=ixgbe-fix profile. launching 6 nodes (g5.xlarge equivalent) in az6 fallback pool. CLI output:
```
provision --zone az6 --image redwood-runtime:stable --count 6 --nic-profile ixgbe-fix
 -> instance i-az6-repl-01..06 created
```
Evan G: nodes booting, attaching to pool. health checks show initial warmed state.
Cheng L: tailing proxy logs to validate TLS errors are decreasing. sample log:
```
[2026-03-14T17:46:22Z] proxy: peer 10.20.5.6 TLS handshake failed: read timeout
[2026-03-14T17:46:28Z] proxy: connection reset by peer
```
Cheng L: after route change + new nodes attach, handshake failures down ~85% over last 3m.
Anna K: good. Customer impact: Support Dashboard shows 14 active customer sessions affected in az6 (mostly low-traffic dev clusters). No major enterprise tenants impacted yet. Flagging targeted emails if persists.
Oncall Rotation: pinging SRE infra team for root-cause: @infra. Noting that NIC vendor sent microcode push earlier today to az6 hosts.
Support Bot: creating incident channel #inc-7289 for customer comms and logging.
Evan G: new nodes passed healthcheck, draining starts on older hosts with flaky NICs. Drain command:
```
clusterctl drain --zone az6 --selector flaky-nic=true --grace 30s
```
Evan G: drain in progress, two flaky hosts remain but traffic for them is negligible now.
Anna K: can we start re-enabling autoscaler? It was throttled earlier. We should be careful until infra confirms microcode patch status.
Cheng L: note for postmortem: correlate microcode push timestamp with TLS handshake spike and BPF NIC metrics.
Rahul P: routing bias will remain for another 10m; will revert to normal if metrics hold. scheduling canary revert command at +25m.
Oncall Rotation: escalation state: monitoring. If error rate drops to baseline (<0.5%) and az6 host health >95%, we will restore weights. Otherwise escalate to PD Tier 2 for hardware replacement.
Anna K: preparing a short internal update for customers: "We detected transient network instability in us-west az6 causing degraded inference for a subset of customers. Traffic is routed away from az6 and replacement hosts are running. We're monitoring and will post updates in #inc-7289." ready to post once evan confirms drains.
Evan G: drains complete for flagged hosts. new nodes handling traffic. infra reports microcode rollback queued for a subset of machines to test if that stabilizes further.
Cheng L: final check: TLS handshake error rate now 0.12%, p95 latency unchanged, pod restarts minimal. Looks stable.
Anna K: marking as mitigated. moving to monitoring phase. will keep channel open for 30m then transition to postmortem.
pagerduty: INCIDENT-7289 status -> acknowledged by Anna K, mitigated
Oncall Rotation: handing off monitoring to night oncall (Oncall Rotation) at 18:30 UTC. please watch for regressions and escalate if >1% error or >10% qps shift.
Support Bot: customer notice sent to affected dev clusters. template used: "We routed traffic away from a transient network issue in us-west-az6; some requests experienced 5xx errors between 17:43-17:52 UTC. No action required."
Anna K: thanks team :thumbsup: creating ticket for full RCA items: NIC vendor microcode, autoscaler safety checks, routing hysteresis thresholds.
Cheng L: adding logs and perf graphs to the ticket (#RCA-7289). closing this thread after handoff.
